device.connect.message: Allow {name} ({host}) to run commands on this computer?
device.connect.message_host: Allow {host} to run commands on this computer?
device.connect.detail: This computer becomes a local device of the platform: agents can run commands here, and the platform reviews every command. It starts restricted: no Full access, and only the device's own working directory. It keeps serving as a login service after you close the app, and keeps the computer awake while operations run. You can disconnect it from the menu bar icon at any time.
device.disconnect_other.message: This computer is connected to {origin}. Disconnect it first?
device.disconnect_other.detail: Disconnecting stops the local device there and logs it out on this computer. The device stays registered on that platform until someone deletes it.
device.resume.message: Let {name} ({host}) run commands on this computer again?
device.resume.message_host: Let {host} run commands on this computer again?
device.resume.detail: This computer accepts the platform's operations again and keeps running as a login service.
device.keep_awake.message: Keep this computer awake more often?
device.keep_awake.detail.while-busy: While operations run, this computer will not go to idle sleep.
device.keep_awake.detail.connected: While the device is connected, this computer never goes to idle sleep; it uses more power and a laptop in a bag can get warm.
device.keep_awake.limits: Keep-awake cannot prevent sleep when the lid of a Mac on battery is closed without an external display, when Sleep is chosen, at a critically low battery or in a thermal emergency. A sleeping computer is offline for the platform.
device.remove.message: Also disconnect this computer and log the device out?
device.remove.detail: This computer is connected to {platform} as a local device. Choose No to keep the device running.
device.ceiling.change.project_reach: Project reach: the whole OS user (os-user)
device.keep_awake.limits_linux: Keep-awake cannot prevent sleep from the lid switch as the system handles it, when Sleep is chosen, at a critically low battery or in a thermal emergency. A sleeping computer is offline for the platform.
